Overview

About the clear acrylic & brushed aluminium sign

An acrylic and aluminium sign layers a clear acrylic front panel over a brushed aluminium backing. The two materials together give depth, a subtle metallic frame and a finish that looks right at home in professional offices and receptions.

  • Front layerClear cast acrylic, 5mm, printed
  • Back layerBrushed silver aluminium composite
  • Size100mm up to 2000 x 1000mm
  • FixingsStand-offs through both layers

Your design is printed onto 5mm clear acrylic, which sits in front of a brushed silver aluminium composite panel. The metal shows through wherever there's no print, so the sign has a polished, architectural feel.

Made to measure from 100mm up to 2000 x 1000mm, it's ideal for company nameplates, reception walls and building entrances.

See the stacked acrylic and aluminium sign for more layers, or browse all acrylic signs.

What's included

  • Printed clear acrylic front panel
  • Brushed aluminium back panel
  • Stand-off fixings

Good to know

  • Designs with open space show off the metal best

Installation & fixing

The two layers are fixed together with stand-offs, which also fix the sign to the wall.

Step by step

Fitting & care guide

  1. 01

    Check the wall

    Make sure the surface is sound, flat and dry. For screws, find out whether it's masonry, timber or plasterboard so you can choose suitable plugs.

  2. 02

    Position the sign

    Hold the sign in place, check it's level with a spirit level, and mark the fixing holes through the pre-drilled corners.

  3. 03

    Fix it

    Drill and plug the wall, then fit stand-offs or screws with caps. Don't overtighten: hand-tight is enough and avoids stressing the panel.

  4. 04

    Using tape instead?

    For VHB tape, clean the wall and sign back with isopropyl alcohol, apply firm pressure for 30 seconds, and avoid loading the sign for 24 hours while the bond builds.

  5. 05

    Care

    Clean with a soft cloth and mild soapy water. Avoid abrasive pads and solvent cleaners, which can scratch acrylic or damage printed surfaces.

You'll need

  • Spirit level
  • Pencil
  • Drill and suitable wall plugs
  • Soft cloth

Check before drilling

Check the wall for hidden pipes and cables, and use fixings suited to the wall and the weight of the sign.

Artwork

Artwork guide

Getting your artwork right first time means a sharper sign and a faster turnaround. Here's what we need.

  1. Best file types

    AI · EPS · SVG · PDF

    vector files (AI, EPS, SVG or a PDF exported from design software) give razor-sharp results at any size. High-resolution JPG, PNG or TIFF files work for photos.

  2. Resolution

    150dpi minimum

    for photos and raster images, aim for at least 150dpi at the final printed size (300dpi for small signs viewed close up). Images taken from websites or social media are usually too small.

  3. Colours

    CMYK · Pantone · RAL

    set artwork up in CMYK. If your brand has Pantone or RAL references, tell us and we'll match them as closely as the material allows.

  4. Fonts

    Outlined or embedded

    convert text to outlines or embed fonts in your PDF, so the lettering prints exactly as designed.

  5. Bleed and margins

    3–5mm bleed · 10mm safe area

    add 3 to 5mm bleed around printed panels and keep important text at least 10mm from the edge.

  6. Cut-to-shape signs

    Separate vector cut line

    include the cut line as a separate vector path. If you don't have one, our studio will create it.

Clear Acrylic & Brushed Aluminium Sign FAQs

Can't see your question? Call 01603 407786 or send an enquiry.

Does the aluminium show?

Yes, wherever your design leaves clear space, the brushed metal shows through.

What file do I need to send?

A vector logo (AI, EPS, SVG or a PDF from design software) gives the sharpest result. Send what you have and we'll check it, or our studio can redraw it.
